monthly_housing_ceiling.label: Housing-only monthly ceiling, not whole-life spending

studio_upfront_deposit.label: Advertised studio deposit exposure, not guaranteed safe or refundable

beophyeon_period_fee.label: Published historical fall-period fee for Beophyeon double, not spring offer

lean_whole_life_target.label: Tight monthly whole-life estimate, no specific room confirmed

datePolicy: Logged source entries retain the original register's 2026-11-06 Seoul/Singapore access date; some receipts are 2026-11-05 UTC. IROS and HiKorea are procedural portal links in the deliverable without separate access entries, so their accessDate is unknown. No external access was repeated for localization; copy editing is not a price, legal or availability refresh.
uncertainties: Spring 2027 dorm fees, deadlines, inventory and check-in dates were not found in the original board check; historical application windows and exchange-only SK Global/I-House terms are not degree-master offers.
Dorm vacation extensions, cleaning gaps, continuous residence, and meal/bedding/utility/deposit inclusions are not guaranteed.

All adverts are dated asking terms, not verified room-specific vacancies, March availability, property condition, document acceptance or safe-deposit endorsements. Gender/age rules apply; original student gender is unknown.
MegaStay Sinchon Korean and English prices conflict; Kingstay deposit table conflicts with older prose. These conflicts are retained. Unpublished sizes, utility caps and laundry costs remain unknown.

No landlord, property record, senior claims, tax arrears, proxy/trust authority, prior deposits, guarantee eligibility or housing-law coverage for a goshiwon/sublet was individually checked. A fixed date, immigration address acceptance or clean building record does not guarantee deposit recovery.

Monthly budgets, commute allowances, setup and temporary-stay reserves are estimates. Lean insurance allowance is not an official NHIS premium or exemption decision; tuition, flights and large emergencies are excluded.

Immigration and lease-report rules need rechecking for the student and exact arrangement. The local outdated 14-day deadline is rejected in favour of national 15-day law; registration timing is distinct from deposit priority.
editingContract: Complete reader-first English and Simplified Chinese with exact numeric/date/external URL multiplicity and corresponding table-cell parity. Local draft only; no Review, stars or public attachment promises.
